widgets_values: MOSS-Image Base text to image: 1024x1024, Euler and ComfyUI's normal scheduler at the vendor's 50 steps, CFG 3 and shift 5. Use at least 50 steps, and raise CFG toward 6 for a short prompt. The normal scheduler gives the sigmas the vendor's pipeline computes before it snaps them to its 1000 training steps, so it lands within 0.0005 of the vendor's schedule; simple lands up to 0.069 away at 50 steps and renders a different image from the same seed. A render here still does not reproduce the vendor's pipeline at the same seed, because that pipeline draws its own noise. ComfyUI's native shift of 5 is the vendor's; add no shift node. Model Sampling SD3 (DGX Monarch) samples at multiplier 1000, which would render noise on this model, so it refuses here. Skip Layer Guidance (DGX Monarch) drops block 22 (zero-based) from the negative pass on every step, the vendor's default; blocks 24 and 26 also help. Clear single_layers to turn it off: the image looks more realistic, but some details can collapse. cfg2 refuses while Skip Layer Guidance is on; clear single_layers to use it. The vendor recommends 1, 1.5 or 2 MP and reports 0.25 to 4 MP working, with sides in multiples of 16; the model trained at up to about 1 MP. The negative is the tag list the vendor's guide recommends; the model card's default is an empty negative. English works best and Chinese is supported. The vendor's pipeline reads up to 4096 tokens after its chat template; ComfyUI sets no such cap. Describe the finished image, put any text to render in double quotes, and use real line breaks where its lines should break. For tag prompts the guide's order is quality, score, meta, year, character, series, artist, then general tags, with @ before an artist name. Base has no post-training or CFG distillation, which makes it the usual target for LoRA training. Comfy-Org's own MOSS-Image graphs can rewrite a short request into a full caption with Text Generate on this same encoder; that step runs on the driver, and its memory is outside dgx-monarch's driver estimate. The INT8 ConvRot DiT files pin an approximate attention kernel on all 42 blocks: single, cfg2 and dp2 ask for the Sol-Attn waiver, and uly2 drops the pin. On uly2 they exactly match one GPU running the same file without its pins: the 2026-10-21 tests measured 0.027 to 0.036 one-step NRMS before that day's INT8 fix and an exact match after it. With any LoRA they refuse on every topology (docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md #129). They also need comfy-kitchen 0.2.39 or newer. This graph uses the BF16 file, which asks nothing. Auto picks Ulysses on a configured pair. In the 2026-10-21 hardware tests, uly2 renders of this graph matched one GPU and stock ComfyUI exactly over all 50 steps on the simple scheduler and ran about 1.5 times as fast as one GPU with the first Spark capped at 2100 MHz; the normal scheduler was measured on the MOSS-Image text to image graph, where uly2 matched too. See docs/BENCHMARKS.md for the walls and docs/VALIDATION.md#evidence-moss-image-base for the scope. ring2 is measured, not granted: without a LoRA it stayed within the 0.10 one-step NRMS floor of one GPU without matching it, a stream with an odd row count asks for the ring-pad waiver first, and ring2 with a LoRA failed its first-use gate, so that pair is not supported. Expects moss_image_base_bf16.safetensors in models/diffusion_models, qwen3.5_9b_bf16.safetensors in models/text_encoders (CLIP type moss_image) and flux2-vae_small.safetensors in models/vae, the FLUX.2 small decoder; the larger flux2-vae.safetensors other FLUX graphs use is a different decoder, and the file of that name in Comfy-Org's MOSS-Image repository holds other bytes again, so never copy it over yours. qwen3.5_9b_int8_convrot.safetensors is a smaller drop-in encoder. Needs ComfyUI 0.42.0 or newer on the driver and every Worker. MOSS-Image Base and SFT, Kromoss and its two LoRAs, the Qwen3.5-9B text encoder and the FLUX.2 small decoder are all released under Apache-2.0. The first render of a new model runs the identity gate, comparing the mesh with a stock single-GPU load before producing pixels. Allow a few minutes for proof renders. Later renders of the same combination skip the gate. This graph is derived from the family adapter and stock node definitions, without a committed reference render. Check filenames and shapes against your artifacts before running it.
